implementationStateAtFreeze: S01-S13 evidence was complete and known; no S14 package, scenario partition, competency profile, smoke trajectory, reproduction comparison, report input, or validation output existed.
frozenQuestion: Can the validated E05 tasks and evidence be released as a reusable benchmark that keeps robustness, repair, memory, plasticity/adaptation, and transfer distinct, preserves failures and censors, and reproduces its successful baseline end to end without outcome-driven composition selection?

suiteAndCompetencyContract.interpretation: The four suites organize reusable tasks. Five evidence axes remain separate because memory and plasticity/adaptation have different interventions, controls, and failure boundaries. No scalar total competency or regeneration score is defined.

s13Roles.chimera_bubble_insertion: exact composition kinetic/complexity comparator; not a validated improvement

core.s12Content: all 2496 immutable matched pairs, preserving the active-repair matched-control null, gradient target-code contrasts, split-relative transfer estimands, and policy-family-specific Bubble/Insertion-versus-Selection boundary
core.priorTaskContracts: S01-S11 specifications, metric definitions, controls, and claim boundaries are normative referenced dependencies, not pooled outcome scores

extended.s13AdditionalSensitivity: all placement-map-1 chimeric rows, including Bubble-Insertion, remain an explicit sensitivity panel
extended.s13SourceTerminals: all descending Insertion-Selection and three-way formation terminals and their assigned downstream logical rows
extended.s13Threshold: all 2016 potential assignments, including evaluated/reused/source-terminal rows and every not_run_prespecified_global_threshold_stop row
extended.s12FailureDetail: all changed-task failure/censor runs, the complete failure catalog, and every subgroup precision row including inconclusive strata
extended.selectionRule: failure-panel status is descriptive release organization only; no extended row may be used to tune or select a core composition

coreExtendedSplit.noCompositionSearch: No composition, assignment map, target, injury, threshold, or baseline is tuned, promoted, or removed using S13 outcomes.

immutableInputs.role: S13 source checkpoints and formation terminals

s12.protectedConfirmation: all 2256 existing holdout pairs across every held-out axis

s13.ruleAppliesTo: core, extended, source-terminal, placement-sensitivity, and threshold assignments without portfolio-specific exceptions

e07UsageSplit.e07Prohibition: E07 policy search, surrogate fitting, model selection, threshold selection, prompt or rule tuning, and early stopping may not read protected-confirmation outcomes. Any final E07 evaluation must retain source terminals, censors, costs, and stopped-row semantics.

primaryFamilies: binary success with full-population terminals retained
restricted opportunity time with budget-plus-one encoding for failure/censor
error area under the fixed horizon
metricContract.countChangingBoundary: S03 deletion, duplication, and insertion use separate identity-cardinality and valid-target order metrics and are not executable permutation tasks in the fixed-identity runner.
metricContract.severityBoundary: Lesion severity is a descriptor vector; reversal is exactly paired in S13, while Sattolo realization is base/window/operator-paired but scenario-ID RNG-unpaired.
metricContract.timeBoundary: Progress-first-crossing and paired-event clocks are distinct and are never substituted.
metricContract.costBoundary: Energy, pressure, reads, state bits, compute, communication, and intervention actions are abstract simulator accounting units.
metricContract.aggregationProhibited: Do not collapse competency axes, tasks, policies, costs, failures, and censors into one benchmark score.

smokeAndReproduction.stabilization: S01 absorbing certificate plus at least two uniform opportunities per identity within 20*n
required: exact source/checkpoint/lesion/result reproduction against the frozen S13 row

requiredGates: specification frozen and schema-valid before packaging
core and extended assignment uses no outcome field
core/extended disjointness and complete S13 main-row union
S12 immutable split and leakage audit
fresh end-to-end smoke and exact replay
failure, censor, source-terminal, and stopped-row accounting

classificationRule.supportive: all required release contents exist and every validation gate passes
classificationRule.null: the release is complete and valid but the fresh baseline cannot be reproduced within a documented non-contract-breaking tolerance
classificationRule.constrainingContradictory: a frozen split, checksum, schema, replay, accounting, leakage, or claim-boundary gate fails

claimBoundary: This benchmark packages transparent one-dimensional simulator tasks and prior computational evidence. Regeneration, repair, memory, plasticity, learning, adaptation, chimerism, pressure, energy, and transfer are operational terms only; the release is not biological, physical, clinical, causal evidence outside the declared interventions, or evidence of a universal best policy.
